selection_reasoning: The spruce sign serves as a wayfinding element containing directional information that guides the player to the black bed's location. This creates a natural information dependency: the agent must first find and read the sign to learn where the black bed is hidden. Both tasks are observable 'find' tasks that don't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge, and the sign-to-destination pattern is a common and intuitive multi-hop structure. The black bed can be placed in a non-obvious location that becomes discoverable after reading the sign's directions.

edges.reason: The spruce sign contains directional text guiding the player to the black bed's hidden location

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task where the player must locate and observe the spruce sign. The sign is at spawn-relative (3, 0, 2). The player must be within 16 blocks and facing toward the sign (within 45 degrees). Facing tolerance reduced from 60° to 45° per ValidatorAgent's analysis: the sign is at ~56° off the player's initial south-facing direction (yaw=0), so 60° tolerance would allow trivial satisfaction at spawn without any player action. With 45° tolerance, the player must actively turn toward the sign.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task where the player must navigate to the stone hut and observe the black bed inside. The bed center is at spawn-relative (12, 0, 0). A max_distance of 8 is used (tighter than default 16) because the bed is hidden inside an enclosed hut — the player must actually approach the hut and look through the doorway or enter it to see the bed. Facing tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is looking toward the bed when nearby.

scene_description: A flat grass field with multiple structures: (1) a spruce sign near spawn (rotation=0, text faces south toward player) containing directional text 'Black bed is hidden inside the stone hut to the EAST', (2) a stone brick hut 10-14 blocks east of spawn containing a black bed with torch lighting and a 1x2 doorway on its west wall, (3) an oak plank building to the northwest as a decoy, and (4) a small cobblestone enclosure as another decoy. The player must find the sign, read its directions, then navigate east to the hut to find the black bed inside.
task_text: Find the spruce sign near you and read its directions, then follow them to find the black bed hidden in the area.
commands: /setblock ~3 ~0 ~2 minecraft:spruce_sign[rotation=0]{Text1:'{"text":"Black bed is"}',Text2:'{"text":"hidden inside"}',Text3:'{"text":"the stone hut"}',Text4:'{"text":"to the EAST -->"}'}
design_notes: Sign rotation=0 ensures text faces south toward player spawn. Stone hut at ~10-14 east with 1x2 doorway on west wall (blocks at ~10,1,0 and ~10,2,0 set to air). Black bed inside at ~12-13,0,0. Torch at ~11,2,0 for interior visibility. Decoy structures add navigational complexity. All within 15 blocks of spawn. Player spawns facing south (yaw=0) so must turn right ~56° to see the sign.
